every endpoint rejects a missing token when a token is configured
triage resolution with only the read token is rejected
every endpoint permits loopback development requests when no token is configured
every endpoint rejects an invalid token
oversized bodies on the ingestion endpoints are rejected with 413
every endpoint rejects non-loopback requests when no token is configured
